notes.title: Dev Brief 9 | A NEW ERA OF SURVIVAL GAMES
notes.content:
[h3]At Monday the 27th we announced that we will move our focus from Shattle to a brand new game - STRIDEN. 
Our main focus is to develop games in a close relationship with you. That’s why we released Shattle at an early playtest in November last year. 

In January we summarized your feedback, our road map and goals. Which led us to a new conclusion - a new game. [/h3]

[h2]A NEW ERA OF SURVIVAL GAMES[/h2]
The game mode in STRIDEN has got good results during closed playtest. We feel that we’re close to a new innovative Game Mode that we have always strived for. STRIDEN is a fast paced survival FPS, where your Rebel Army needs to unleash your inner spirit, loot and fight for survival.
In a close combat environment, but with the feeling of Open World.  

 
[h2]THE BEST FROM SHATTLE TO A NEW IP[/h2]
We have taken the best from Shattle and the spirit of Shattle in to a totally new game where we can guarantee that you will find more joy and fun.
The game mode in Shattle is unclear and has’t work out that well in what you and we want it to be. 


[h2]ENDLESS POTENTIAL[/h2]
STRIDEN is made from scratch with our own code. The Lead Programmer has made a huge result and difference that will make endless potential and scalability to STRIDEN. With our new Game Design Document and Feature Document we will be able to implement all of the new innovative stuff that we’re working on. 


[h2]DEV TEAM[/h2]
The team has grown during the last months. We have more expertise in new areas that will complete a much more pleasant experience. 
We’re are very critical to every pice of what we do at the moment. Every feature, level design, character, animations etc. gets more time and evaluation to make the best game experience for you. 



We can’t wait to tell you more and we will do that starting from august. 
Here is our announcement from last Monday. 
[previewyoutube=FgAGCc9MKIk;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]FAQ:[/h2] 

[h3]WHAT WILL HAPPEN WITH SHATTLE? [/h3]
Shattle will not go for launch. But if you like Shattle we can guarantee that you will like STRIDEN even more. 
The spirit of Shattle will be in STRIDEN. 

[h3]ARE YOU STILL GOING TO USE THE CURRENT MAP?[/h3]
Yes, Bergbyn will be back in STRIDEN. Not in the beginning but in the future. 
Bergbyn needs to redone, but it will be back and bigger…

[h3]WHAT WILL HAPPEN WITH WEAPONS, ARMOR AND TRAPS?[/h3]
There will be more weapons, armor and traps. This is one of the main feedbacks that you have told us. 
It will be faster and easier to get weapons for a more fun weapon play. 

[h3]WILL THERE BE BIRDS IN STRIDEN?[/h3]
There will be more, you liked the feature and we have pushed it further ;) 

[h3]WHERE IS STEAM PAGE FOR STRIDEN?[/h3]
There will be a steam page and wishlist of STRIDEN. We will announce that with our first teaser during the autumn.

notes.title: Dev Brief #8 | Introducing Stronghold Mode
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

For today’s devlog we’re going to be talking about a major change that we have been working on since our last playable build, our gameplay mode.

If you’ve been following our journey along the way on our social channels, you may have seen us use phrases like “the game will never be the same again” or “You’ll hardly recognize it.” While they may be overused cliches in gaming marketing today, we want to convey that when we say everything will change, we mean it.

Our previous mode, which featured three bombing runs that forced you into the shelters with the opportunity to go outside and scrounge for loot, is completely gone. It is now being replaced with what we call [b]Stronghold mode[/b]. 

To start with, you are no longer fighting on your own. When you enter Stronghold mode, you’ll be placed in a lobby where you can pick your team, select one of five different classes with unique loadouts, and voice chat with team members to talk strategy. These classes also mean that you no longer start empty-handed. Instead, you’ll begin with a basic weapon depending on your class. In addition, you will be able to customize your clothing in your character menu before you play, but it’ll be up to you to find or craft armour. 

This new change encourages team play and allows players to set the match's pace.

Stronghold mode takes place in 3 phases: Prepping, Stronghold and Battle for Survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/3df13c095caf91ca3c2875315a47f240ac389b1f.png[/img]

Like in our last game mode, this phase is about gathering as much material, weapons and gear as possible to build your army. Finding loot won’t be easy, as you’ll have to find special hiding places on the map where loot will be randomly spawned to create more of a dynamic match.

Another major change we’ve introduced is removing your hunger and thirst needs. Instead, any food you find along the way will help give you back some health, and water will bring back stamina.

We’re also introducing special map missions to unlock secret spots on the map and earn team currency (more on that later). Anyone on the team can perform these missions and you won’t need special items to complete most of them, but teamwork can be very important to pull these off. 

All of our maps will include various choke points where opponents are forced to fight it out in close quarter combat and open spaces giving players more freedom to move around. Of course, where you go is all up to you and your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/97e5b97f6f576839957870ec2891506450148c72.png[/img]

This is where things get really interesting.

During the stronghold phase, players are now encouraged to go into their defensive phase. Bombs are going off outside, and it’s time to get into our bunker and claim your stronghold.

Each stronghold will be your team's main point of operation going forward. Like a game of capture the flag, you and your team will have to work together to find and claim your spot before other teams can get to it. Once you’re in there, you and your team can close the stronghold door, use your newly unlocked crafting bench and use your collected resources to get to work. 

We’re also introducing an earned currency system where players can use that towards the team budget allowing you to build more defences, amenities like water sources and upgrade your crafting benches. A better level of workbench means better gear. The team currency can also be used to buy mystery boxes that may contain some valuable loot that will come in handy for the fight ahead.

The catch? There are not enough strongholds to go around. By design, there will always be one team without a spot to call home. This team will now be called the Saboteurs and will be given access to a special control room where they can wreak havoc on their opponents. The saboteur team also gets the opportunity to buy mystery boxes where a random weapon spawns.

If you die here you will still re-spawn (more on that later), but you won’t be able to get back into the bunker until phase 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/d8992c7a491f1576423b32705a7d38f13147be7f.png[/img]

The bombing has stopped, bunker gates are open again and it’s time to get to your evacuation bus. This time though buses work a bit differently than before.

Instead of a driver pulling up to take all players to safety, teams will now have to track down the bus, get the bus ready and take it over in a capture the flag style gameplay. Fortune favours the bold, so the only way to win is to go on the offensive in this winner-take-all ending.

Oh! And those players that you managed to take down in phase two? They’re back now but not as you might remember them. All players that have re-spawned from phase two on have become animals and are back with a vengeance to help their team. Respawning players will have a choice of what animal they want to come back as. So now you have to fight off humans as well as their moose, bear and wolf friends. Good luck!

If you manage to fend them off and capture your bus, you and your team will be rewarded with a cut scene to celebrate your victory.

So that’s a short look at our new Stronghold mode. While we’re excited to show it to you once it’s ready, we want to emphasize that this is still a work in progress, and things may still drastically change before we present you with our playable build.

[h1]So why Stronghold mode?[/h1]

So you might be wondering why we made this change? After months of playtests and player feedback, we realized that our previous system was too unclear, and most players didn’t really know what to do next. 

We believe that Stronghold mode gives players clearer objectives and reasons to play as a unit. The game will feel more dynamic, fast-paced and give you and your teammates more opportunities for strategic gameplay, just as we intended from the start.

Have any questions or want to see developments as it happens? Join our Discord server. We’ll keep dropping new screenshots and videos as we continue development.

               - 5 Fortress Dev Team

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3wGCq4R9ht][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/29a793c4cc5e4d47e2331dcbdf228e41c23dafa5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dev Brief #7 | New changes, bigger team and a new office
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re coming up for air one more time as we’re deep into our development cycle. We have some really cool news to share with you on what’s going on with Shattle and how 5 Fortress as a company is growing. So without further ado, let’s get into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/155260b60e6c5d3cdcf9c4459255aa82f7cbb27b.png[/img]

You've probably seen glimpses of our new and upcoming assets and cover art if you’ve been following us on our social media channels. We’ve mentioned before that we’re getting a new look and feel, and our art department has really stepped it up. This new cover art you can see above, created by our talented Lead Game Artist Patrik, shows off our characters, what to expect from the game and even hints at some of our future features for those with a keen eye. We’ll go into more details on the changes down the line, but expect more of the same as development continues.

Speaking of our teams, we have recently begun to scale up our dev teams in the programming and UI/UX departments. One of the first challenges we have them tackling is completely re-doing our inventory system. 

Our old system was outdated, generic and did not fit our gameplay and early testers felt it was clunky. It got the job done for our initial build, but we know we can do better. So now we’re building it from scratch and creating something unique to our game that actually works as intended. Look for more updates on that as we go forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/a7c0c00e73606025d40cbe6a985e4e3e4a166f5a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/d142b60733eae89119b5c0292690bf9a4f12d193.gif[/img]

Next up, our new FPS mode is shaping up nicely. While we’re still early in the process and a lot of work still needs to be done to make it look and feel great for players, our external QA company has come back saying they really like it from their first impressions. We’ve explained in earlier devlogs why this change is important to Shattle, so the development team is committed to nailing this feature. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/4c182b320ae966c6da3895279bb7216bb865f3f5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/a5e697d3c1a475df0feca64904debb5ca8b72e07.png[/img]

Our newest map Vargen is continuing to come together, as you can see in our latest WIP pictures above (more on that in a future blog). But it’s not the only thing we’re building at 5 Fortress.

While we’ve created the game mostly remotely, that’s soon to change as we move into a new office next month. Located in Boden, Sweden, the new space will allow us to work closely with each other again, collaborate more on game development as we move forward with Shattle and potentially give you more opportunities to learn more about us and our team. So look for new office news in the future!

That’s it for this week. As always, you can catch up with us on our [url=https://twitter.com/5Fortress]social channels[/url], and if you want to learn more about Shattle or ask the devs questions, make sure to join our Discord channel as well.

         - 5 Fortress Dev Team

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3wGCq4R9ht][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/29a793c4cc5e4d47e2331dcbdf228e41c23dafa5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dev Brief #6 | Major Changes Coming
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, 

Sorry you have not heard from us in a while. We’re proud to announce that we have expanded our team and have moved into a new phase of development so that means we have a lot of work to do in the coming months as we prepare Shattle with some major changes.

Before we get into exactly what those changes are, we want to thank everyone who has taken the time to take part in our playtests. All of your valuable feedback is what is driving our development team going into our next phase, and all of our changes are being made with you and your gameplay experience in mind.

We’re not going to go into details on each change this week (though look forward to more feature deep-dives in the near future), but here is a list of what we are working on:

[list]
[*] Shattle is turning into an FPS
[*] Our current game modes are being built from the ground up to have a greater focus on teamwork
[*] Redesigning our inventory system to be better and faster
[*] Our crafting system is being re-done from scratch
[*] New and improved respawn mechanics that actually make a difference
[*] Introducing a progression system for players
[*] Reimagining current and future map layouts with our new gameplay in mind 
[/list]

We can’t end this devlog without talking about the current crisis in Ukraine. As developers, it saddens us to see the toll on human lives and the devastating destruction going on right now. In respect of the Ukrainian people and everyone affected by this situation, we are changing the way we present and talk about Shattle. This includes graphical profiles, word choices and sound effects. 

If you want to know more, ask the developers questions and be the first to see our updates, join our Discord server.

         - 5 Fortress Dev Team

notes.title: Thank You Playtesters! | What's next?
notes.content:
A big thank you to everyone for taking part in tonight’s playtest! It was great having you all try out our latest build. 

If you haven't already, fill out our post-game survey here: [url=https://forms.gle/s4dRprnXm19SbyQ16 ]https://forms.gle/s4dRprnXm19SbyQ16 [/url]

We have good news and bad news. 

The bad news is this will be our last playtest for a while. We’ve got some great notes and feedback through our last series of playtests and it’s time for the devs to once again get back to work on all of our much-needed changes and improvements.

The good news is that we have already begun working! We’re planning a major overhaul of gameplay, as we just don’t think the game is fun enough in its current state. The next time you will play Shattle it’ll be a completely new experience.

A preview of some of the things we’re working on:

[list]
[*] Redesigning the game mode from scratch 
[*] Improving the air raid system
[*] Experimenting with an FPS mode
[*] Cleaning up and polishing all UI/UX elements
[/list]

Check out some of our FPS experiments (as well as a new map preview) below!

[previewyoutube=6QqQfnWgIh4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are not done with playtests forever though, look for them to continue in the coming months. Stay tuned to our social channels including Discord to find out when the next ones will be. We’re also going to continue giving you all dev updates as we move forward.

notes.title: Patch Update 0.0.2.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=XUg8HMhcPv0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Patch Update 0.0.2.0[/h1]

After months of work, we are finally live with our latest patch. The Invasion has Started update includes a lot of changes that have been suggested by you the players. It's been six weeks since we revealed Shattle to the world and so far we have gotten some great feedback from you all.

The game is being created but just us three developers, and we're pleased to see how your feedback has helped shape and evolve Shattle into what is it today.

We hope that you will enjoy the new changes! And as a special gift to you all this holiday season, we are keeping our servers running 24/7 until January 2, 2022.

Happy Holidays! 

[h3]Gameplay/Features [/h3]
[list]
[*] New AI system implemented. 
[*] AI enemies are now lootable. 
[*] Now you only need one player to start a match. 
[*] Added an instant re-spawn button if you get killed. 
[*] No more magazines for weapons. New reload mechanics. 
[*] Less recoil for submachine guns and assault weapons. 
[*] Less spread for range weapons and pistols. 
[*] Faster projectile for all weapons. 
[*] Increased the maximum stacking Ammunition 
[*] Increased the time before the first Air-raid starts to allow for more looting. 
[*] Shorter Air-raid times, giving players more time to explore. 
[*] Increased the wait time for the evacuation bus. 
[*] New event music and voiceovers. 
[*] A re-designed main menu with a new theme for Shattle. 
[*] A bigger inventory grid for your starting underwear. 
[*] Thirst losses are slowed and give less damage. 
[*] Melee weapons don't spawn in the Weapon Spawner category. They use the same spawn category as build parts/resources. 
[*] More range weapons are available in the basement. 
[*] Crafting table added in basements. 
[*] More loot in bedroom drawer (weapons and ammunition added). 
[*] New weapon crosshair. 
[*] Bombing rates are lower during Air-raids. 
[/list]

[h3]New Weapons [/h3]
[list]
[*]  Mauser 96 Bolt Action Rifle 
[*]  Browning HP Pistol 
[*]  AK-47 Assault Rifle 
[/list]

[h3]New Equipment [/h3]
[list]
[*]  Military gasmask 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/0020a55f3d55a4601fb6b052c0062bc2f6ed7b7c.jpg[/img]


[h3]Map Changes (Bergbyn) [/h3]
[list]
[*]  New theme (Invasion has started). 
[*]  Night light setting. 
[*]  Real-time volumetric fog. 
[*]  More props and debris to use as cover. 
[*]  More sections on the maps are populated to get a greater experience. 
[*]  New small building has been added in between apartments. 
[*]  New soundscape for the map to make it more atmospheric. 
[*]  Barricades have been removed to the military sections. 
[*]  Balcony rails have been lowered. 
[*]  Easier to navigate in destroyed parts of apartments with wooden planks added over holes in the floors. 
[*]  Staircase destruction does not create more blocked areas. 
[*]  More cover available inside the Shelters. 
[*]  Added more variations of ground foliage. 
[*]  Added more rubble and debris on the ground. 
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/43a33f636463fdf5aca8250eee30fdc276ddaf4a.jpg[/img]


[h3]Sounds [/h3]
[list]
[*]  Added one more level of sfx for hearing weapons at range/distances. 
[*]  New ambient sounds for Bergbyn. 
[*]  Enemy AI have subtle but different footstep sounds. 
[*]  Dummy voices for AI. 
[*]  New music theme. 
[/list]

[h3]Known key issues [/h3]
 [list]
[*] Chambering weapons like Shotgun & Bolt Rifles take too much ammo from the inventory after the first round. 
[*]  No reloading sounds on weapons with magazine reload animations. 
[*]  AI damage reactions won't work at all. They will not react to damage if they do not see the player. 
[*]  Sometimes the AI stands brain dead at doors. 
[*]  Sometime AI loses a player as a target in a firefight. 
[*]  AI shooting animation plays when they is not shooting. 
[*]  Event sounds are playing together, sometimes making a mess of sounds and music. 
[*]  Apartments floors are flickering and glitching on some parts of the maps. 
[*]  Placeholder weapon animations. 
[*]  Placeholder melee animations
[/list]



Don't forget to join our Discord to talk with us.

notes.title: Dev Brief #3
notes.content:
[h1]Christmas is almost upon us, and that means our newest patch is almost out - The invasion has started.  We have previously talked about how we have added our new AI system and made major changes to the map. This time we want to talk about our next biggest challenge: our new weapons system. [/h1]

Previously, there was a lot to juggle. You needed a weapon, a suitable magazine, specific ammunition to fit that weapon and the ability to put it all together. It was complicated, messy and a bit too hectic for players, especially in close combat situations. It made it a more frustrating experience and took you out of the immersion, according to testers. 

[h3]So we went back to our tried and tested method - If you don't like it, we change it as fast as possible. We want you to have a great time with the games we are developing. [/h3]

The solution was to rewrite the entire weapon code for ammunition and magazines. Now we have managed to not only make a game-ready version but, more importantly, one that is ready to be tested in our playtest environment. 

[b]All you have to do now is find a weapon and have the right ammunition in your inventory.[/b] Press [R] and you are ready to take on the enemy.

With the AI and a longer loot time before the first air-raid, you will have more opportunities to find a firearm and defend yourself. We have been careful where we placed more powerful weapons early in the game. We placed the more "realistic" weapons that can be in a basement such as:

● Shotguns
● Bolt Rifles
● Pistols
● Crafted Weapons


[b]We also have added 3 new weapons to the game:[/b]

● Mauser 96 Bolt Rifle - Used in the Swedish army during the First and Second World War. A powerful rifle with room for 5 7.62x39mm rounds. The fire rate is not the fastest but if you aim correctly it can be a one-shot-kill.

● Browning HP Pistol - A dream gun for those who collect weapons. A powerful pistol that uses 9mm rounds.

● AKA Assult Rifle - The AI’s weapon of choice. It can be yours if you manage to kill them! Extremely powerful in class with the AK4. This weapon also uses 7.62x39mm rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/d66e4f874dd0c670fac2c9622e7261b406b5ba7a.jpg[/img]

We also made the weapons easier to use. We added a new Crosshair that will make it easier to hit people from a distance and we have also reduced the spread and recoil on all weapons. It is important to mention that all our weapons today use placeholder animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/78146c4d39a601cf7d1a50769fe1d7497ce0498f.jpg[/img]

More weapons mean that more players will need ammunition. For now, we are still restrained as we want it to be challenging to find loot and gear to survive in the game. But we want to make it easy to understand where to find ammo.

[b]Our new Ammunition Box! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/f41a6cf73920603cdeae817e45ca00c4659557fc.jpg[/img]

You can find a smaller amount of ammunition in those boxes. If you are afraid that it will run out as soon as a player has been there, you can breathe easy. They are refilled automatically after a certain time. But the best chance of finding a lot of ammunition is still from Airdrops or the military sections of the shelters.

[h3]But don’t forget! A crafted Potato Gun, with the ammunition of potato with nails, is more deadly than a shotgun.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/27b78abdf8a95e7b56c88be1f724a968687af972.jpg[/img]

Have a great weekend and we look forward to when we can release our new patch. Keep up to date here and our social channels to learn more.

[url=https://discord.gg/UfQQTDRAkx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/29a793c4cc5e4d47e2331dcbdf228e41c23dafa5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dev Brief #2
notes.content:
[h3]When we started developing Shattle, the idea was to create the happy 70's in Sweden. Hippies, nice colours and constant sunshine. We wanted to move away from classic game environments with broken objects, dirt and mould. After the recent changes that have been made, we felt that the identity of Shattle was lacking. We saw that those of you who tested the game had difficulty really feeling the story through gameplay. So we decided to change that and move the war from being just beyond the horizon to your front door. [/h3]

We call it - The invasion has started. This allows us to expand upon the story and make it more concrete. Through clips, we will explain why unidentified soldiers have invaded the streets and why Air-Raid signals keep going off. 

[h3]The Rescue bus [/h3]
It will become more apparent why you have to catch the bus. For one example: You will not get any points or a chance to win if you don’t get a seat on the bus. Therefore, it is even more important to find the right loot and gear to survive until the bus arrives. 

[h3]Updates on the map. [/h3]
The warm sun has set for the day, and an eerie fog is starting to cover the map as we move into the night. You will see that battles have taken place, and the map is now much colder and more atmospheric. We have also added more elements to use as cover during gunfights. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/373d542d2594385316bbb6c72b4da9e403cd8d42.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/5ee4e99ee67372021ec50e3d397da3cd811edb1c.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/c5c8f74939e47b2c16464e041288638e9552cd76.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/5f8cc8545d656bbaad600935dd9aae045de9ea33.jpg[/img]

[h3]Updates on AI[/h3]
With a new system AI coming, it is more important than ever to quickly find weapons to defend oneself. It will be easier to find firearms such as pistols and rifles in the upcoming patch. If you want more advanced firearms, this will be as usual. Be the first to Air-drops or find the hidden places underground. If you succeed in eliminating an AI, take the opportunity to loot. They might carry valuable things that increase your chances of survival. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/d444102c089bf45faca38497f7679b8a3a019671.jpg[/img]

We look forward to releasing our patch soon and seeing what you think of our new way of developing Shattle. 

[h3]We want to make it clear again - the game is at early stage. [/h3]

We have many placeholders as an example: Weapon animations and movement. But we always try to make sure that each patch is as free from bugs as possible so that you get a good feeling of the game. 
So have a great Friday everyone, and don’t forget to ask us more in our Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/UfQQTDRAkx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118945/29a793c4cc5e4d47e2331dcbdf228e41c23dafa5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: December Update | Message from the Devs and New December Playtest Times
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Once again thank you for signing up for our playlets! You probably don’t know how much we appreciate your feedback and engagement in the game that just three of us developers have made so far. We have learned so much and one of those lessons that we learned - get players collected at the same time during playtesting, so all of you can get an honest perspective of Shattle. 

So with that said we have decided to close servers in between scheduled playtest times. This way we will not only save on server costs during this stage of development, but we can provide a much better experience for you with 25-players at the same time. We’re also working on a new patch to create a better experience and an early Christmas gift. 😉
